$comment: Stands in for GET /api/v1/admin/users/vocabularies. Labels, tones, the allowed membership transition matrix, the profile schema, the metric definitions and the open decisions this module renders on screen. The panel reads ALL of this rather than hard-coding it, so a membership status, an activation source, a profile field or a metric caution added server-side renders with no code edit. Static copy (labels, help text, cautions) is permanent; nothing in this file is a placeholder record.
$comment_profileSchemaVersion: The field set completeness_pct is computed against. Stamped onto the user_profile row so a later schema change cannot silently re-grade an old profile as incomplete.

classifications.label: Normal User
classifications.derivedFrom: no membership record has ever been active
classifications.meaning: Registered on the platform with no current active membership entitlement.

classifications.label: Active Member
classifications.derivedFrom: current membership is Active and today is inside its entitlement period
classifications.value: The current paying and entitled base.

classifications.label: Paused Member
classifications.meaning: Membership temporarily paused under policy. Entitlement behaviour follows the pause rule.
classifications.value: Still a customer, temporarily not consuming.

classifications.label: Suspended Member
classifications.meaning: Entitlements administratively withheld for a policy, risk or operational reason.

classifications.label: Former Member
classifications.derivedFrom: membership history exists and none of it is currently entitling
classifications.meaning: Held a membership at some point; holds none now.

classifications.label: Deactivated
classifications.meaning: The ACCOUNT is administratively disabled. This is not a membership classification and is never merged with one.
classifications.value: Excluded from every active-base count, present in every history.

membershipStatuses.label: Pending Activation
membershipStatuses.meaning: The membership record exists; the entitlement is not live.
membershipStatuses.advance: An approved activation source is verified and the entitlement snapshot is taken.

membershipStatuses.label: Active
membershipStatuses.meaning: The member is receiving entitlements against a frozen plan-version snapshot.
membershipStatuses.advance: Paused, Suspended, Cancelled, Expired, or renewed into a new term.

membershipStatuses.label: Paused
membershipStatuses.meaning: Temporary and resumable. The end date freezes, extends or continues according to the pause policy.
membershipStatuses.advance: Resumed back to Active, or Suspended or Cancelled from here.

membershipStatuses.label: Suspended
membershipStatuses.meaning: Administrative restriction. Access is withheld; history stays intact.
membershipStatuses.advance: Reactivated by an authorised decision, or Cancelled or Expired.

membershipStatuses.label: Expired
membershipStatuses.meaning: The entitlement term reached its end without a renewal.
membershipStatuses.advance: Terminal for this term. A renewal is a NEW record referencing this one.

membershipStatuses.label: Cancelled
membershipStatuses.meaning: Intentionally terminated before the term would have ended.
membershipStatuses.advance: Terminal for this term. A later membership is a new record.

transitions.guard: Activation needs an approved source AND a successful entitlement snapshot. A snapshot failure aborts activation rather than producing an Active membership whose access nobody can enumerate.
Every lifecycle action needs the matching authority and a stated reason. Expiry is reached by the scheduled sweep, not by a person.
Resume recalculates the entitlement dates ONLY according to the configured pause policy — UM-OD-04, open. The system does not guess.
Reactivation needs restricted authority and a recorded reason.
Terminal. A renewal creates a new term carrying previous_membership_id; this record is never rewritten.
Terminal. A new membership may be created later; this one stays visible and unchanged.

lifecycleActions.label: Activate
lifecycleActions.help: Verifies the activation source, freezes the entitlement snapshot from the plan version in force, and sets the term live. Refuses if the snapshot cannot be taken.

lifecycleActions.label: Pause
lifecycleActions.help: Temporary and resumable. What the end date does while paused is UM-OD-04 and is not decided — this screen states which rule it is applying rather than assuming one.

lifecycleActions.label: Resume
lifecycleActions.help: Puts entitlements back. Dates move only if the configured pause policy says they move.

lifecycleActions.label: Suspend
lifecycleActions.help: An administrative restriction, not a pause. Needs restricted authority — profile-edit permission is not enough — and a reason that goes into the audit trail.

lifecycleActions.label: Reactivate
lifecycleActions.help: Lifts the restriction. The reason is recorded because who decided this was safe again is asked after the fact, not before.

lifecycleActions.label: Cancel
lifecycleActions.help: Terminates the term. Refund handling belongs to Finance — cancelling here writes no money anywhere.

lifecycleActions.label: Renew
lifecycleActions.help: Creates a NEW term referencing this one. The previous record is never rewritten, and a renewal is never counted as a new member.

activationSources.label: New sale
activationSources.help: Somebody bought this for the first time. The reference points at the record in Deals, Invoicing or Finance that took the money — this module stores the pointer and never the amount.

activationSources.label: Renewal
activationSources.help: An existing member bought another term. It is a NEW record linked to the one before it; the previous term is never extended or rewritten.

activationSources.label: Complimentary
activationSources.help: Granted without payment. Needs the membership-lifecycle permission and a stated reason — a grant with no recorded authority is the misuse this rule exists to prevent (UM-BR-05). It creates entitlement and no revenue.

userStatuses.label: Deactivated
userStatuses.help: Soft. The user keeps their profile, membership history, commercial links and audit trail — hard deletion is a governed privacy process and is not a button here (UM-BR-16).

tags.label: High intent
tags.help: Told us on a call they want to buy. Internal only.

tags.label: Payment risk
tags.help: Finance flagged a dispute or a reversal.

suspendReasons: Payment dispute under review by Finance
deactivateReasons: Member asked to close the account
$comment_renewalWindowDays: Drives expiring-soon AND the renewal-rate denominator. It is a placeholder until UM-OD-11 fixes the window and the grace period — the screens say so rather than presenting it as settled.

metricDefinitions.label: Total registered
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct platform_user rows retained as of the period end.
metricDefinitions.caution: Includes Normal Users, members and former members. Excludes deactivated accounts from the ACTIVE base but never from history.

metricDefinitions.label: New registrations
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct users whose registered_at falls in the period.
metricDefinitions.caution: Failed and partial registrations are excluded at intake, not here.

metricDefinitions.label: Normal Users
metricDefinitions.formula: Registered users with no currently entitling membership.
metricDefinitions.caution: Derived at read time from membership state — there is no stored flag to drift.

metricDefinitions.label: Active Members
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct users whose current membership is Active and inside its entitlement period.
metricDefinitions.caution: Paused and Suspended members are customers but are NOT counted here — they are not entitled today.

metricDefinitions.label: New members
metricDefinitions.formula: Users whose FIRST-EVER membership activation happened in the period.
metricDefinitions.caution: A renewal is never counted here. That is the single most common way this figure gets inflated.

metricDefinitions.label: Registration to Member
metricDefinitions.formula: First-time activations divided by the eligible registration cohort in the window.
metricDefinitions.caution: Cohort conversion, not a period ratio. Dividing this period's first-timers by this period's registrations compares two different populations.

metricDefinitions.label: Renewal rate
metricDefinitions.formula: Renewed terms divided by terms actually eligible to renew in the window.
metricDefinitions.caution: Never divide by all registered users. The denominator is memberships, and the window is UM-OD-11.

metricDefinitions.label: Membership churn
metricDefinitions.formula: Eligible terms ending without renewal divided by the eligible ending cohort.
metricDefinitions.caution: Membership churn is not account deactivation. The two are counted separately and must never be added together.

metricDefinitions.label: Expiring soon
metricDefinitions.formula: Active terms whose end date falls inside the configured renewal window.
metricDefinitions.caution: Moves the moment the window in UM-OD-11 is fixed. So does the churn denominator.

metricDefinitions.label: Revenue per active member
metricDefinitions.formula: Membership-linked collected revenue READ FROM FINANCE divided by the defined active-member denominator.
metricDefinitions.caution: Contextual. This module never calculates revenue and never holds a ledger. The scope of what counts is UM-OD-12.

metricDefinitions.label: Profile completion
metricDefinitions.formula: Users meeting the configured completion threshold for profile v1.
metricDefinitions.caution: Re-graded when the profile schema versions. Old rows keep the version they were graded against.

metricDefinitions.label: Active users / MAU
metricDefinitions.formula: Distinct users with at least one qualifying platform event in the window.
metricDefinitions.caution: UNAVAILABLE until UM-OD-10 defines the qualifying-event taxonomy. Shown as unavailable, never as zero.

openDecisions.title: Membership plan ownership
openDecisions.position: This panel CONSUMES the existing Plans catalogue rather than defining one. Whether the plan tables live in Users Management is a schema decision and is unconfirmed.

openDecisions.title: Activation trigger
openDecisions.position: Which commercial event automatically activates a membership is undefined. Every automatic activation on these screens is stated as an assumption.

openDecisions.title: Complimentary memberships
openDecisions.position: Offered here behind an explicit source and a mandatory reason. Whether they are permitted at all is undecided.

openDecisions.title: Pause policy
openDecisions.position: The pause modal states which rule it is applying and does not guess. Freeze, extend or continue changes the renewal queue and the churn denominator.

openDecisions.title: Suspension effect
openDecisions.position: Which customer surfaces stay available while suspended is undefined, so the suspend modal promises nothing specific.

openDecisions.title: Refund consequence
openDecisions.position: A refund does not automatically move a membership here. Finance stays authoritative and the consequence is an explicit lifecycle event.

openDecisions.title: Profile schema
openDecisions.position: profile v1 is the field set on these screens. Which fields are public and which are admin-editable is unconfirmed.

openDecisions.title: Engagement taxonomy
openDecisions.position: No qualifying-event taxonomy exists, so DAU/WAU/MAU render as unavailable rather than as zero.

openDecisions.title: Churn definition
openDecisions.position: A 60-day renewal window and no grace period are assumed and labelled as assumed everywhere they are used.

openDecisions.title: Membership revenue KPI
openDecisions.position: One contextual figure, labelled as read from Finance. Which products count is undefined.

openDecisions.title: Entitlement keys
openDecisions.position: The keys on these screens are illustrative. The snapshot contract with the customer platform cannot be written without the real ones.

openDecisions.title: Concurrent memberships
openDecisions.position: Overlapping active terms for the same product are refused. Whether different concurrent products will exist is unconfirmed.

$comment_activationSources: THREE, and the list is deliberately short. It used to carry payment / invoice / deal / manual / legacy, which mixed two different questions: WHY the term exists (a first sale, a renewal, a grant) and WHERE the money is recorded (a deal, an invoice, a payment row). The second is not a source — it is a reference, and it is one free-text field on the form. Somebody choosing between five near-synonyms picks inconsistently, and the analytics built on that choice inherit the inconsistency.
